records.content:
Goal:
Make the catalog service return every page of search results.

Known requirements:
- Fetch all catalog pages in order until the service reports no next page.
- Change only catalog_service.py and tests/test_unit_catalog.py; do not create or modify any other path.

Late steering 1:
- When pages overlap, keep the last occurrence of each duplicate item ID because a later page should be treated as newer data. Preserve the order of the retained occurrences.

Late steering 2:
- Final correction: supersede the earlier duplicate rule. Keep the first occurrence of each duplicate item ID in first-seen order, and keep the caller's filters unchanged.
